rules.people: Real people only as court records, SEC findings or official reports record them.
rules.numbers: Every number on screen is said in the narration and traced to a named public source.
rules.pictures: Public-domain pictures (National Archives, Library of Congress, federal agencies' own photos and documents) and the free-licence footage rules already in this repo; court and agency documents shown as documents.
